## Description {#details}

<p>A module pass for msan instrumentation.</p>


<p>Instruments functions to detect unitialized reads. This function pass inserts calls to runtime library functions. If the functions aren't declared yet, the pass inserts the declarations. Otherwise the existing globals are used.</p>
